tasks.title: World streaming, placement and population
tasks.brief: Find one measured performance or robustness win in world streaming, chunk meshes, placement, culling or population. Use qa_world_perf/qa_world_stream/qa_game_soak to find a real hotspot or leak; do not chase speculative micro-optimisations.
acceptance: A before/after measurement on the same spot or a reproducible leak that is fixed
No visible regression in the world at the measured spot

tasks.title: Vehicle handling and traffic AI
tasks.brief: Improve one concrete vehicle or traffic behaviour: low/high-speed handling, handbrake, landings, collision response, stuck cars, traffic lights, lane following or AI recovery.
acceptance: A focused QA script or mission bot run demonstrates the change
No new stuck-car or NaN behaviour in a short soak

tasks.title: Combat, weapons, police and ragdolls
tasks.brief: Improve combat readability, fairness or robustness: hit feedback, damage curves, enemy accuracy, wanted-level flow, arrest/bust logic, ragdoll transitions or weapon sanity. Prefer a player-visible fix with evidence from qa_game_combat.
acceptance: qa_game_combat or a targeted headless script shows the intended behaviour
No page errors or NaN entities in the monkey gate

tasks.title: Story missions and side quests
tasks.brief: Improve one mission/quest behaviour: objective clarity, fail-state fairness, cleanup/leaks, replay/save handling, cutscene/dialogue timing or an unfair combat/driving beat. Use tools/bot.js on the affected mission.
acceptance: The affected mission completes in tools/bot.js
No mission-marked peds/vehicles/markers leak after completion

tasks.title: HUD, menus, input, audio and ambient life
tasks.brief: Improve one readability/feel issue in the HUD, map, menus, prompts, radio/audio mix, pedestrian activities or ambient scenes. Take before/after screenshots for visual changes.
acceptance: A screenshot or focused headless check shows the improvement
No runtime errors, audio-state assertion or entity leak

tasks.title: Pedestrians, camera and effects
tasks.brief: Improve one ped behaviour, camera transition, hit/impact effect, interaction prompt or pickup behaviour. Prefer a player-visible improvement with a focused headless check or screenshot.
acceptance: A focused headless script or screenshot shows the change
No page errors or NaN entities in the monkey gate
